Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.filemanager

Class ArchiveOperations

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.filemanager.ArchiveOperations
public final class ArchiveOperations extends Object
Archive (compression) operations for the file manager, built entirely on the JDK's java.util.zip so a produced .zip opens in any unzip tool and any standard zip can be extracted here. No third-party dependency.

Reliability. createZip(java.util.List<java.nio.file.Path>, java.nio.file.Path, java.util.function.LongConsumer) streams into a sibling .part file and atomically moves it onto the target only once the whole archive is written, so an interrupted run never leaves a truncated .zip behind. Unreadable files are skipped rather than aborting the archive.

Security. extract(java.nio.file.Path, java.nio.file.Path, java.util.function.LongConsumer) is hardened against the Zip Slip vulnerability: every entry is resolved against the destination and rejected if it escapes it (absolute names, ../ traversal), so a hostile archive cannot overwrite files outside the chosen folder.

Deliberately free of Swing/AWT imports so it can be exercised headless. Long-running loops report cumulative byte progress through an optional LongConsumer (driven from a SwingWorker).

    • isArchive

    • createZip

      public static boolean createZip(List<Path> sources, Path destZip, LongConsumer progress)
      Creates a ZIP archive at destZip holding every source (recursing into directories). Entry names are relative to each source's parent, so a selected folder is archived under its own name.
      Parameters:
      sources - the files/folders to archive
      destZip - the target .zip (parent created if needed)
      progress - receives cumulative bytes written (may be null)
      Returns:
      true if the archive was written and moved into place

    • extract

      public static boolean extract(Path archive, Path destDir, LongConsumer progress)
      Extracts archive into destDir (created if absent), guarding every entry against Zip-Slip path traversal.
      Parameters:
      archive - the zip file to read
      destDir - the folder to extract into
      progress - receives cumulative bytes written (may be null)
      Returns:
      true if extraction completed without a fatal error
